fix.t: Update to OpenPLC Runtime version 4.3.0 or later.

items.title: Elecbrakes EB2, VM1, ELBC2000

fix.t: Elecbrakes has released updated firmware (EB2 3.0.4.4.3). Users should open the Elecbrakes app and install the firmware update.

items.title: Exposed Dangerous Method or Function in Elecbrakes EB2, VM1, and ELBC2000

fix.t: Elecbrakes has released updated firmware (EB2 3.0.4.4.3). Users should open the Elecbrakes app and install the firmware update.
Elecbrakes has released updated firmware (VM1 1.3.4.2.1). Users should open the Elecbrakes app and install the firmware update.
This device is the predecessor to the EB2 and the VM1 and is no longer sold. The vendor is determining how to address these vulnerabilities for this particular controller.

items.title: The affected product is vulnerable to an integer underflow which may allow a remote attacker to cause a denial of service, memory corruption, or information disclosure.

fix.t: The repository owners of libumqtt did not respond to CISA's request for coordination. Users are encouraged to reach out to libumqtt for support. Their GitHub page is located at https://github.com/zhaojh329/libumqtt.
